title: User Guide
text: Freshwater recreational creel data made publicly available Washington’s official open data portal, data.wa.gov. Creel datasets comprised multiple elements (e.g., effort, interview, catch data) grouped space time “Fishery Name” identifier. identifier easy way view given creel’s full dataset. example, Skagit winter steelhead 2021 dataset contains effort counts, angler interviews, etc. conducted sections Skagit Sauk rivers 2021-02-01 2021-04-15. Fishery Name function fetch_dwg downloads creel data data.wa.gov Fishery Name primary route accessing complete dataset fishery. don’t know Fishery Name? function fetch_fishery_names(), arguments, returns list fishery names creel database. know part Fishery Name specific syntax? function search_fishery_name() can accept vector characters numbers returns fishery names values.
code: library(creelutils)  fishery_name <- "Skagit winter steelhead 2021" dat <- fetch_dwg(fishery_name)  #ll stands for latitude and longitude names(dat)  colnames(dat$effort) fetch_fishery_names() |> head(n = 10) # by water body search_fishery_name("Humptulips") |> head(n = 5)  # by run / species search_fishery_name("winter steelhead") |> head(n = 5)  # by year search_fishery_name("2025") |> head(n = 5)

title: Fetch raw creel datasets — fetch_data
text: https://www.data.wa.gov/ can occasionally throttle data requests. rate limitation intermittent may cause fetch_data fail. user may register app token prevent occurring. takes couple minutes. Step 1: Register app token Create free account data.wa.gov —> click Sign -> Sign top right corner logged , navigate profile -> Developer Settings -> Create New App Token Fill Application Name (e.g., CreelEstimates) Description. fields can left blank Click Save copy App Token value (Secret Token) Step 2: Store token R environment Open .Renviron file: usethis::edit_r_environ() Add following line, save close file: SOCRATA_APP_TOKEN=your_token_here Restart R, confirm token accessible: Sys.getenv("SOCRATA_APP_TOKEN") return token, "" WARNING: Renviron stored locally tracked git.

title: Summarize HMC Diagnostics from a Stan Fit — get_hmc_diagnostics
text: function reconstructs diagnostics similar rstan::check_hmc_diagnostics() returns formatted character string instead printing console. allows output saved, displayed, logged programmatically. function summarizes key Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) convergence diagnostics Stan model fit. intended help users assess whether tuning needed using available options like adapt_delta, max_treedepth, prior adjustments. diagnostics reported include: Divergent transitions: less 5% post-warmup iterations. Divergences may indicate poor exploration posterior often require increasing adapt_delta (e.g., 0.75 toward 0.95 0.99) reduce step size. Smaller steps improve numerical stability increase runtime. Maximum tree depth: iterations saturate maximum tree depth. Saturation may co-occur high adapt_delta due long trajectories. frequent, consider increasing max_treedepth default (usually 10–12). E-BFMI: metric checks whether energy transitions HMC efficient. E-BFMI 0.2 sign potential sampling issues, though reparameterization (typically recommended) accessible workflow. Instead, consider revisiting prior distributions improve geometry. function adapted return results text, contrast rstan::check_hmc_diagnostics() prints directly console.

title: creelutils 0.2.0
text: Overhaul database connectivity streamline user experience Store user credentials OS credential manager keyring package (#19). Relocate local config.yml working directory package creelutils called user-level dotfile stored ~/.config/creelutils (#22). Implement lazy database connections fetch_db_table() wrappers R/query_helpers.R (#26). New fetch_data() serves generalized method querying raw datasets either Postgres database directly public views hosted https://data.wa.gov (#29, #30). Previously fetch_dwg() allowed downloading public data source. internal option direct approach limitation waiting public views sync preset schedule. paths now return type-identical output (internal route includes several additional metadata columns), database-sourced data feeds cleanly downstream CreelEstimates Stan models. New plot_zipcodes() produces heat maps angler-reported ZIP codes individual states full US (#18). New fishery_catchgroups_obs() leverages fishery_catchgroups() raw catch table produce tibble reference catch groups interest given fishery filtered just observed catch data (#20). New catchgroups_to_params() helps convert catch group component fields (.e., species, life_stage, fin_mark, fate) vector format used wdfw-fp/CreelEstimates/template_scripts/fw_creel.Rmd YAML param params$est_catch_group (#28).

title: creelutils 0.2.0
text: Fixed fishery_catchgroups() querying wrong database view (#15). Added missing params argument transform_estimates() prevent environmental scoping issues using ETL (#24). Added bit64 Suggests (#30).

title: creelutils 0.2.0
text: Removed experimental function render_progress_report() (#17). fetch_dwg() folded fetch_data() now serves wrapper new generalized data querying function (#29).
